title: Asahi MFA deployment preflight and staging service-principal isolation
scope: Fail-closed HTTPS OIDC JWKS/CSRF config validation and isolated staging password-authenticated PostgreSQL service principals. No production provider, certificates, secret vault, load balancer or customer sign-off.
environment: GitHub Actions unit/integration and disposable staging Compose; not production

criteria.given: An enabled BFF without complete configuration and privilege preflight
criteria.then: Startup fails before public approval routes are registered

criteria.given: Privileged/sharing PostgreSQL roles, wrong OIDC endpoint, unsigned JWKS or missing verified TLS setting
criteria.when: The preflight examines the deployment config and role observations

criteria.given: Two real PostgreSQL 16 staging service logins with separate passwords
criteria.when: Staging Compose runs isolated issuer/approver probes
criteria.then: Each login has only its function grants; cross-role escalation is rejected

criteria.given: Production network and authorized enterprise IdP with monitoring and storage
criteria.when: Service deploys, restarts, rotates secrets and recovers from failure
criteria.then: TLS verification, shared rate limit, audit, rollback and real user acceptance are evidenced

blockers: Staging password login checks run over private Compose network without production TLS verify-full
Preflight configuration flags are operator attestation, not proof of live ingress/rate-limiter/IdP compliance
No real provider E2E, restart/restore acceptance for approval service, or user sign-off
